decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains a niche option with uncertain long-term contracts and low keeping costs, so the option is still kept open.
The spring-balanced desk lamp is a low-cost option with a dedicated page but limited strategic alignment, so it is kept while prospects remain uncertain.
The general interior luminaire is core to the firm's main market and aligns with its direction, so the drop risk remains minimal.
As the flagship pendant luminaire central to the firm's strategic direction, it is kept with very low abandonment risk.
The marine HMI searchlight is a niche non-LED product with questionable value after two years, so the option is abandoned to release resources.
